title.zh: CFTC 发布规则与提案，将事件合约纳入掉期监管并排除赌场式押注
title.en: U.S. CFTC moves to fold event contracts into swaps regulations as legal fight rages

current_state.zh: The CFTC has excluded casino-style wagers from its swap definition, bypassing a formal proposal and citing threats to prediction markets, while noting the move alters no existing compliance obligations.
current_state.en: The CFTC has excluded casino-style wagers from its swap definition, bypassing a formal proposal and citing threats to prediction markets, while noting the move alters no existing compliance obligations.

updates.title_zh: U.S. CFTC moves to fold event contracts into swaps regulations as legal fight rages
updates.title_en: U.S. CFTC moves to fold event contracts into swaps regulations as legal fight rages
updates.what_changed_zh: The U.S. CFTC issued one rule and proposed another to formally classify certain event contracts on prediction-market platforms as 'swaps' under its exclusive oversight, hardening its legal position against states challenging its jurisdiction.
